design.purpose: Make a six-pointed paper snowflake decoration for one person to display flat or hang in a window.

steps.c: Place the 21 cm square paper flat.
Fold the top-right corner onto bottom-left.
Fold the top-left corner onto bottom-right.
Fold the top-right edge through top at 30°.
Fold the top-left edge through top at 30°.
Cut a shallow curve across the wide end.
Cut a small notch from the left edge.
Cut a small notch from the right edge.
Open the sheet out flat to reveal snowflake.
